title: On a slow line a help question is saved but the member is told it was not, and its reply never shows
what: When the help box is slow (over about 25 seconds while the AI writes its answer), the phone gives up, says 'Couldn't send', and removes the question from Your questions, though the server already kept it. Tapping Send again files a second copy. The team's reply to the first copy is never asked for, so it never shows on the phone, even though the reply alert still arrives.
expected: A question the server may have kept stays in Your questions as waiting, a second tap reuses the same question rather than making a new one, and any reply to it shows.
how_often: when the help box answers slowly
fix_line: Keep the question as waiting after a timeout and send it again under the same question key

title: When MettleUp's help server is down, the member is told to check their own internet
what: Any server error from the help box, or both addresses failing, shows 'Couldn't send. Check your internet and try again.' The same words show when the phone is online and the fault is on MettleUp's side.
expected: A server fault says the help service is having trouble and to try again later; only a real lost connection talks about the internet.
fix_line: Use different words for a server error and for no connection

title: Several 'try again' messages leave no note of why it failed, including a workout that will not save
what: The 'Couldn't save your workout. We'll keep trying.' banner is raised with the error, but the error itself is never written to the phone's log. The same is true of the gym connect and sign-in errors, the AI key save, the spreadsheet save, loading the demo, a profile change that did not save, and a profile that could not be read (the card just stays empty).
expected: Every failure that shows 'try again' writes one log line saying what failed and why, so a phone log or crash report can explain it.
fix_line: Add one warning log line with the error in each of these failure branches

title: When a workout will not save, a restore fails or an account will not delete, MettleUp never hears of it
what: The member app reports only crashes to MettleUp. Failures it catches and shows calmly, such as a workout that keeps failing to save, Finish failing, a backup restore failing, the account delete failing during Erase, or Erase leaving things behind, stay on the member's phone. We learn of them only if a member or gym tells us.
expected: The serious caught failures send a short report without personal data (like the crash report), so a pattern shows up before a gym complains.
how_often: every caught save, restore or delete failure
fix_line: Send the existing crash report for these caught failures too, marked as handled

title: The member app counts nothing about use, so backup, restore, account and help decisions are made blind
what: The member app sends no usage counts at all. Nobody can see how many members save a backup file, restore one, sign in to the MettleUp account, connect to a gym, use the voice note, or open Help. Only the 'Did this solve it?' tap on help answers is kept.
expected: A few counts without personal data, such as backups saved, restores done, account sign-ins and help questions per week, so choices like turning the account on are based on numbers.
fix_line: Add a small anonymous weekly count of these actions, sent to our own server
